args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with `healthy: false` and an elevated error rate (0.18). Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production, while v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release.

2. **Rolled back**: checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The rollback was verified (`status: rolled_out`).

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the rollback to v2.3.0; the on-call engineer was paged.
